reason: Hypothesis A directly addresses the stated limitation of void formation and phase separation by proposing a vapor-coated Cu layer on W particles before SPS, cites relevant evidence on sintering inhomogeneities, and provides a clear, testable falsification experiment with specific measurements and a baseline. Hypothesis B introduces ALD without supporting evidence, makes an unsupported claim of transient liquid phase bonding (physically questionable below Cu melting point), and lacks grounding in the cited literature.
